paragraphs: Bitfocus builds Clarity Human Services, the case record system a community uses to coordinate housing and services for people who are homeless. The pitch is aimed at continuums of care that need to move people into housing and show funders what happened.

The system covers coordinated entry, case planning, and outreach work done in the field on a phone. It joins up records from across the continuum so agencies stop keeping separate copies of the same client. Reports can be generated against HUD, SOC, HIPAA and local standards, and access is scoped by role. There is a separate configuration for domestic violence providers, where client safety and privacy are treated differently.

Alongside the software the company sells services: system design, health evaluation, training, and taking over day-to-day administration of the system. Bitfocus describes itself as founder-led and says it talks regularly with HUD, USICH, NAEH and Community Solutions.
